snippet.title: PEAK: The Final Ascent | Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
August 11 PST. 

We’ve been hard at work crafting PEAK’s final Major Update, and we're finally ready to drop it to the shore near you. Ok well, I guess near a peak...near you. Whatever ANYWAY This update comes with new variant biomes: GLOOM and THE CITADEL, which will cycle out with CALDERA and THE KILN!

There's also a new secret for you to discover, but for now...

See you in the gloom...

Scoutmaster Myres VA: Xalavier Nelson Jr. from  ⁨@StrangeScaffold   !!

Get PEAK here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3527290/PEAK/

https://peakpeakpeak.com/
